races.paceDynamic: Suir Monad and Nicky Larson will set a sustainable early pace with no genuine speed merchants in this field. The soft going will further blunt any early tempo, creating a rhythm that builds gradually through the middle sections. Mount Eden, Stellar View, Lunar Tide and Gatlinburg all prefer to come from off the pace but may find themselves closer than ideal given the lack of genuine front-runners. This race shape clearly favours horses that can travel prominently and sustain their effort, punishing pure hold-up performers who rely on strong early pace to set up their finishing kick.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Travellers Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace remains genuinely sedate as expected
scenarios.body: The lack of early speed allows prominent runners to travel comfortably before quickening, while hold-up horses struggle to make up ground on the testing surface. Suir Monad and Nicky Larson can dictate terms throughout.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Surprise Early Tempo
scenarios.trigger: If Sir Aston or Mighty Wave show unexpected early speed from their unknown styles
scenarios.body: A faster early gallop opens up the race for closers, allowing the talented hold-up performers to showcase their ability. Stellar View and Lunar Tide benefit most from this pace injection.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Soft Ground Grind
scenarios.trigger: If the soft conditions create an attritional test of stamina
scenarios.body: The testing surface finds out horses lacking genuine staying power, favouring those with proven soft ground form. Nicky Larson's 2/2 record on similar going becomes crucial.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Bolger Special Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Mighty Wave shows significant improvement for Jim Bolger despite recent poor form
scenarios.body: The master trainer produces another surprise package from a lightly-raced type, capitalizing on the race's moderate pace. His ability to improve horses dramatically cannot be ignored.

watchPoints.text: Only One Scobie has been beaten an average of 25 lengths in recent starts and can be completely ignored
Sir Aston's market support will reveal connections' confidence in this expensive but unraced newcomer
Mighty Wave could be a Bolger special despite poor recent form, watch for any market confidence
Suir Monad's early positioning will dictate the race tempo given his prominent running style
Nicky Larson's soft ground prowess makes him dangerous if positioned handy to the pace early

races.paceDynamic: The Blue Panther is the lone front-runner and should get an uncontested lead with Rock Basher, Not Simple, and She's Ideal settling in prominent positions but unlikely to pressure early. This creates a sustainable pace that won't burn out the leaders, with a large group of hold-up horses including Hell Left Loose, Zephron, and Famous Enough needing to make up ground late. The soft going will make it harder for back-markers to close effectively over this mile trip. This race shape clearly favours prominent runners and those with early pace who can position close to The Blue Panther without having to come from too far back.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Pace Holds
scenarios.trigger: If The Blue Panther sets a steady tempo without being harassed early
scenarios.body: The prominent runners travel smoothly into the straight and have enough left to hold off late challenges on the testing ground. Hold-up horses find it difficult to make significant inroads from the back of this large field.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely slow and kickback doesn't hinder closers
scenarios.body: The soft ground proves less taxing than expected and allows the better-handicapped hold-up horses to unleash telling late runs. Fresh horses returning from breaks find an extra gear when it matters.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front-Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If The Blue Panther gets into an excellent rhythm and opponents fail to get competitive
scenarios.body: The leader builds an unassailable advantage turning for home and never gets caught despite the large field. Prominent horses battle for the minor placings behind a decisive winner.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If The Blue Panther stops quickly and the prominent runners also fade badly
scenarios.body: The conservative early gallop leaves everyone with something left but the leaders capitulate dramatically in the final furlong. An unfancied hold-up horse with stamina emerges from the pack to cause a surprise.

watchPoints.text: The Blue Panther must handle the 172-day layoff as the lone pace-setter facing 16 rivals over a testing mile
Hell Left Loose carries 7lb more than his course victory in October and both recent runs were over shorter trips
She's Ideal and Famous Enough are returning to turf after winter AW campaigns and need to prove surface transfer
Not Simple and Rock Etoile both show concerning patterns of fading in the finish which could be costly here
Master Garvey has raced frequently and comes here just 8 days after his Dundalk third, potential bounce risk

races.paceDynamic: Magna Gee Gee will take this field along from the start with no other confirmed front-runners to challenge his early supremacy. With Sarangpur, I Do Believe and Prom Queen likely to race prominently, there should be modest pressure through the early stages but nothing excessive given the extended trip on soft ground. The tempo will be steady rather than fierce, setting up a tactical finish where stamina and a strong finishing kick become paramount. This race shape clearly favours hold-up horses who can stay the trip and produce late acceleration, with the patient tactics likely to be rewarded.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays modest and the finish becomes a stamina test
scenarios.body: The patient hold-up brigade will have conserved energy for a sustained drive, picking off the weakening leaders in the final two furlongs. Horses with proven staying power and late pace will excel in this grinding finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Sarangpur or I Do Believe press Magna Gee Gee early and quicken the pace
scenarios.body: The increased tempo will stretch the field and favour horses positioned within striking distance who can sustain their effort. Those with the tactical speed to be handy but not committed to the lead will benefit from the honest gallop.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Steals It
scenarios.trigger: If Magna Gee Gee gets an uncontested lead and the field is slow to respond
scenarios.body: The soft ground and extended distance could allow the leader to build an unassailable advantage, with the chasing pack leaving their challenge too late. This becomes a tactical blunder by the field rather than front-running brilliance.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If the tempo becomes pedestrian and turns into a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure speed test over the final three furlongs, suiting horses with a turn of foot regardless of their usual running style. Those with the highest turn of foot rather than stamina will prevail.

races.paceDynamic: Holy See will likely dictate proceedings from the front with no other confirmed front runners to pressure him early. This sustainable gallop over 1m4f on soft ground will allow the race to develop into a tactical affair where positioning becomes crucial in the straight. The lack of early pace pressure means horses with prominent styles like Star Harbour, Granite Bay and Denim And Diamonds can track the leader comfortably, while hold-up horses like Whimsy, Zoffman and Robbies Rock will need the pace to quicken sufficiently late to showcase their finishing kicks. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can position close to the pace and have the tactical speed to respond when the race develops.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Gallop Benefits Prominents
scenarios.trigger: If Holy See sets an even gallop without much early pressure from the field.
scenarios.body: The prominent runners can sit perfectly positioned behind the leader and strike with superior tactical speed when the race develops in the straight. Star Harbour and Granite Bay are ideally suited to this scenario with their ability to travel strongly in behind.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Get Strong Pace
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners apply enough pressure to Holy See to create a genuine test.
scenarios.body: This forces a stronger gallop that will set up the race perfectly for the hold-up horses who can unleash their finishing kicks. Whimsy and Robbies Rock benefit most from this tactical development with their proven ability to finish strongly.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Holy See Wire-To-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Holy See gets completely uncontested fractions and the field fails to mount a serious challenge.
scenarios.body: The lack of pace pressure allows Holy See to dictate completely and kick clear when asked, with the field unable to make up the ground in testing conditions. His prominent style becomes a winning front-running display under these circumstances.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Muddle Favours Outsiders
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes stop-start with multiple horses trying to make moves simultaneously.
scenarios.body: The messy tactical battle creates opportunities for horses at bigger prices who can find gaps and take advantage of the scrambling finish. This chaotic scenario can benefit those with the lowest expectations and best value.
